context: Mei and Ren chat about living alone.
purpose: Casual register; vocabulary (電気/病気/ひとり/普段/両親) in natural home.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: ひとり暮らし、慣れてきた?
lines.en: Have you gotten used to living alone?
lines.style: soft warm woman voice, gentle caring delivery throughout

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: うん、普段は問題なく過ごしてるよ。
lines.en: Yeah, day to day I'm doing fine.
lines.style: warm young man voice, soft warm relaxed delivery throughout

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 病気の時は、ひとりだと心細いね。
lines.en: When you're sick, being alone is lonely.
lines.style: gentle woman voice, soft warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 前に病気で、両親に頼っちゃった。
lines.en: Once when sick, I relied on my parents.
lines.style: honest young man voice, soft warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: ご両親、近くに住んでるの?
lines.style: curious woman voice, gentle warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: うん、普段から連絡を取ってるよ。
lines.en: Yeah, I keep in touch with them regularly.
lines.style: warm young man voice, soft warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 電気代も、ひとりだと気になるよね。
lines.en: Electricity bills bug you when you live alone.
lines.style: gentle woman voice, soft warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 普段から、電気をこまめに消してるよ。
lines.en: I diligently turn off the lights as a habit.
lines.style: cheerful young man voice, soft warm affectionate closing delivery throughout
